The sum of the first \( n \) terms of a GP is given by:
\[ S_n = \frac{r^n - 1}{r - 1} \]
where \( r \) is the common ratio. Here, \( r = 4 \).

Thus,
\[ S_n = \frac{4^n - 1}{4 - 1} = \frac{4^n - 1}{3} \]

We need \( S_n \) to be a four-digit number, i.e., \( 1000 \leq S_n < 10000 \).

So,
\[ \frac{4^n - 1}{3} \geq 1000 \]
\[ 4^n - 1 \geq 3000 \]
\[ 4^n \geq 3001 \]

Taking the natural logarithm on both sides:
\[ \ln(4^n) \geq \ln(3001) \]
\[ n \ln(4) \geq \ln(3001) \]
\[ n \geq \frac{\ln(3001)}{\ln(4)} \]

\[ \ln(4) \approx 1.386 \]
\[ n \geq \frac{8.006}{1.386} \approx 5.78 \]
